description: ONE-call token intelligence for trading decisions: rating (grade, 15-step grade_detail, GPA, outlook, verdict, lifecycle), per-venue grades, unanimous-club membership, microburst quality score, warning severity/convergence, prediction hit-rate + history, KG fill, 1d cross-exchange spread, open/blocked transfer routes, PLUS coverage (Coverage Grade v0: A-D score of how well NightWatch observes this asset, with per-layer L1-L8 booleans) and bti (Bot-Tradability Index v0: per-strategy verdicts ok/limited/no/unknown with reasons and limit_usd for arbitrage, momentum_swing, market_making, lending_short, plus overall t_grade). Call this FIRST before deciding what to do with a token. Requires: exchange, symbol.
name: get_token_intel
